description: Standard TPC-H DDL with a handful of hand-written rows, just enough for Q6 (filter + SUM, exact decimals and date bounds), Q3 (three-table join, GROUP BY, SUM, ORDER BY with ties) and Q4 (correlated EXISTS). Order 1 hosts the Q6 lineitems, orders 10-16 the Q3 ones, orders 20-26 the Q4 ones; each group is excluded by the other queries' predicates.

cases.name: q6
cases.note: Lines 1,2,3,9 qualify: date bounds 1994-01-01 inclusive / 1995-01-01 exclusive, discount 0.05 and 0.07 inclusive, quantity 24 excluded; line 9 repeats line 1's values (bag duplicate).

cases.name: q6_no_match
cases.sql: SELECT SUM(l_extendedprice * l_discount) AS revenue FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= DATE '1992-01-01' AND l_shipdate < DATE '1992-01-01' + INTERVAL '1' YEAR AND l_discount BETWEEN 0.06 - 0.01 AND 0.06 + 0.01 AND l_quantity < 24
cases.note: Q6 text with the year moved to 1992: no row qualifies, the scalar aggregate still yields one row with SUM NULL.

cases.name: q3_shape_sum_count
cases.sql: SELECT l_orderkey, o_orderdate, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM customer, orders, lineitem WHERE c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING' AND c_custkey = o_custkey AND l_orderkey = o_orderkey AND l_shipdate > DATE '1995-03-15' GROUP BY l_orderkey, o_orderdate
cases.note: Q3 shape without the order-date filter or ORDER BY: bag comparison; COUNT(*) per group; order 15 now included, order 16 (AUTOMOBILE) still excluded.

cases.name: q3
cases.note: Orders 12 and 13 tie on (revenue, o_orderdate): either order is correct. Fewer than 10 groups, so LIMIT does not cut.

cases.name: q3_limit_2_boundary_tie
cases.sql: SELECT l_orderkey, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS revenue, o_orderdate, o_shippriority FROM customer, orders, lineitem WHERE c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING' AND c_custkey = o_custkey AND l_orderkey = o_orderkey AND o_orderdate < DATE '1995-03-15' AND l_shipdate > DATE '1995-03-15' GROUP BY l_orderkey, o_orderdate, o_shippriority ORDER BY revenue DESC, o_orderdate LIMIT 2
cases.note: Standard Q3 text with LIMIT 10 replaced by LIMIT 2: the cut falls inside the {12, 13} tie run, so the second row may be either order.

cases.name: q4
cases.note: Order 21 has two late lines but counts once; 22 has none late; 23 and 24 fall outside the three-month window; 25 has no lines.
